Khecarakaumudī
jy. by Jayarāma Daivajña. B. IV. 120. CPB. 1130. Viśvabhāratī 217 (l).

Khecaracandrikā
jy. by Yogeśvara. Oudh XIV. 54.

Khecaratuṅgādiprakāśikā
jy. 9 verses. by Śivānanda Gosvāmin alias Śiromaṇi Bhaṭṭa (a southerner, a. of Ācārasindhu, Āhnikaratna, etc.) who visited Bikaner during the reign of Anupsingh. Bikaner 4496.
See also K. M. K. Sarma on the a., D.. C. Kunhan Raja Presentation Vol. p. 363.

Khecaratvasiddhi
mantra. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 21.
--from Mahākālasaṁhitā. TD. XX. Sup. no. 35.

Khecaradīpikā
jy. by Kalyāṇa; date used for calculations 1649 A. D.; on its mss. in U. S. Libraries, see David Pingree, Trans. Am. Phil. Society N. S. LVIII. iii. 1968, p.. 61-3.

Khecarapaddhati
jy. by Mādhavasiṁha. Oudh XIV. 56.

Khecarabhūṣaṇa
jy. by Bhānujit. B. IV. 120.

Khecararaktavajrayoginīsādhana
Bud. by Vāguri (?) Cordier II. p. 58.

Khecaravidyā
from Kālikā(Kāli)krama. Nepal II. p. 247 (inc.).

Khecaravīryasādhana
jy. from Keśava's Jātakapaddhati. PUL. II. p. 213. [Page188-b]

Khecarasiddhānta,_ºsiddhi
or laghukhe. siddhi jy. in 20 verses. by Śrīdharācārya. Intro. verse 2 mentions the year Śaka 1149 (1227 A. D.).
IO. 2930. Oudh XX. 118. RASB. X. 6842.
Q. by Harihara in his Gaṇitacūḍāmaṇi, IO. 2924.

Khecarītantra
Dacca 1663A (inc.).
See Kh. vidyā below.

Khecarīvidyā,_ºpaṭala
from mahAkAlayogazAstra or mahAkAlasaMhitA tantra. by Ādinātha Pārvatīputra of Nātha school. in 4 Paṭalas; Umā-Maheśvara-saṁvāda.
Allahabad 174. B. IV. 2. Baroda 4109. Bik. 1279. Bomb. Uni. 2015-16. BORI. 129 of Ā882-83. CPB. 1131. 1331. Cop. 9. Dacca 1663A (inc.). (Khecarītantra). Jodhpur 921. K. 38. MT. 2831 (e) (a..).
